text:
Rosa Li: quick convo  experimenting with three entry patterns for first-run: bottom shelf, corner tile grid, and small popover. attaching comps:
https://fig.redwood/onboard/shelf.png
https://fig.redwood/onboard/tile.png
https://fig.redwood/onboard/popover.png
Which should we prototype for a 2-week experiment?
Ethan (Design): tile grid feels friendlier for sample projects (visual affordance). shelf is subtle, popover is interruptive.
Priya Rao: agree on tile for discovery. but worried about cognitive load on the projects page if tiles compete with actual projects.
Jordan (Metrics): past data: highly-visual patterns lift browse metrics but sometimes reduce immediate project creation. we can track impression->click->create. need event names.
Nate (a11y): accessibility concerns: popover must be announced to screen readers and support ESC to close; tile grid needs consistent heading structure and skip link; shelf requires clear dismiss control and focusable CTAs.
Ethan (Design): thanks nate 72 i'll add ARIA roles and make sure tile headings are h3s under main h1.
Rosa Li: copy options thrown together:
```
Variant 1 headline: "Get started with a working sample"
CTA 1: "Open sample"
Variant 2 headline: "Kick off a project in seconds"
CTA 2: "Start project"
Variant 3 headline: "Browse ready-made apps"
CTA 3: "Explore samples"
```
Priya Rao: short verbs work better on small CTAs. my pick: CTA 1 for tile, CTA 2 for shelf, CTA 3 for popover.
Jordan (Metrics): propose experiment split: 33% tile, 33% shelf, 34% popover for new accounts. power calc: need ~3k newsignups per arm for statistically meaningful create rate comparisons.
Nate (a11y): also include keyboard-only participants quota in test plan. small percentage of users use only keyboard; we should ensure parity.
Ethan (Design): tiny visual nit: tile images need 1px focus ring in dark theme. current comp hides focus due to rounded masks.
Rosa Li: implementation notes: tiles are client-side only, shelf needs server flag for persist dismissed state per user, popover requires focus trap. can we scope tickets?
Priya Rao: I'll scope UX acceptance criteria: 1) clear affordance to create vs browse, 2) keyboard navigation through all elements, 3) telemetry hooks for impression/click/create.
DeployBot: Feature flag created: exp.onboard.patterns.v2 enabled for 34%/33%/33% split.
Jordan (Metrics): setting up events: onboard.impression, onboard.cta_click, onboard.sample_open, project.create. will add funnel dashboards and shared doc: /drive/onboard/exp_v2_kpis.
Nate (a11y): quick checklist i'll run after initial build: screen reader announce, ESC close, tab order, color contrast. posting results here after QA.
Ethan (Design): follow-ups: update Figma frames with focus states, upload assets to /assets/onboard/v2, annotate spacing tokens.
Rosa Li: action list: Ethan update comps by tomorrow noon, Priya write acceptance criteria, Dev team to stub flags (assigning ticket to @dev-team), Nate run checklist after build, Jordan monitor funnel.
Priya Rao: tagging @growth for conversion oversight and @support to watch for onboarding friction in first 48h.
Rosa Li: thanks team. we'll reconvene in 10 days to review preliminary numbers. :rocket:
